definitions.explanation: Relating to an individual's personal matters or private life, as opposed to public or official matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私的|してき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{私的|してき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to value my private time.

examples.japanese: {私的|してき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went on a personal trip.

notes:
{私的|してき} is a na-adjective meaning private or personal, contrasting with anything public or official. It is relatively formal and often appears in written or semi-formal speech.

FORMS:
- {私的|してき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun: private (modifier)
- {私的|してき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: privately, personally (adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私的|してき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: a private matter
- {私的|してき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: personal reasons
- {私的|してき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: personal/private time
- {私的|してき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: a personal trip

NOTE ON READING:
Same reading as ⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧ (pointing out) — completely different words. Context usually makes the meaning clear.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公的|こうてき}→公的：06349_kouteki⟧: public, official (antonym)
- ⟦{個人的|こじんてき}→個人的：04788_kojinteki⟧: personal (more common in everyday speech than {私的|してき})
